title: Comment on “Incidence and risk factors for recurrence, metastasis, and malignant transformation of ameloblastoma”
html: The authors of the article “Incidence and risk factors for recurrence, metastasis, and malignant transformation of ameloblastoma” present an important dataset addressing recurrence and malignant potential in ameloblastoma1; however, I am concerned that the conclusions drawn—particularly the recommendation for radical surgery—may not be fully supported by the data presented and risk conveying an unbalanced message to the wider surgical community. The reported recurrence rate of 49.9% following conservative treatment is high and is presented alongside discussion of malignant transformation, implicitly linking the two.
